description: NaBSiO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pca2₁ space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.75 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.38 Å. There are two inequivalent B sites. In the first B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of B-O bond distances ranging from 1.48-1.50 Å. In the second B site, B is bonded to four O atoms to form BO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four SiO₄ tetrahedra. There are two shorter (1.48 Å) and two longer (1.49 Å) B-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four BO₄ tetrahedra. There is one shorter (1.63 Å) and three longer (1.64 Å) Si-O bond lengths. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four BO₄ tetrahedra. There are three shorter (1.63 Å) and one longer (1.64 Å) Si-O bond length. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one B, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one B, and one Si atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one B, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one B, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one B, and one Si atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one B, and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one B, and one Si atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Na, one B, and one Si atom.
